weapons.name: Assault Gun
weapons.desc: Steady automatic fire. Each round pierces up to 2 ALTERs. The only weapon that keeps firing during a dash.

weapons.name: Beam Rifle
weapons.desc: Fast beam that punches through up to five ALTERs. Fires faster the faster you move.

weapons.name: Mortar
weapons.desc: Lobbed shell that steers in flight to land on its target. Huge blast; the center stuns, and stunned enemies take 1.5x damage from your side.
